$comment: Performance budget (feature 009-perf-budget / P1.8). Gzip KB limits on client JS weight, checked in CI by scripts/perf-budget.mjs. Set above today's real numbers so they guard growth, not fail on day one. Bump deliberately in a PR when a real increase is justified.

sharedFirstLoadJs.note: gzip of rootMainFiles + polyfillFiles from .next/build-manifest.json — the First Load JS shared by every page (current ~166 KB, 056)

totalClientJs.note: gzip of every .next/static/chunks/*.js incl. deferred chunks like three.js (current ~702 KB, 057). Raised from 680 deliberately: without the ui barrels (057) a module shared by several pages can be copied into more than one chunk, so the build's sum grew ~44 KB while what each page downloads fell 28–49 KB (shopperPageJs, perf:lab). This sum counts chunks no single visitor loads together.

shopperPageJs.note: gzip of every chunk the prerendered /about-us and /contact HTML links, heaviest page — the root layout's JS included (current ~215 KB, 059; 293 KB in 056 before the ui barrels went, ~339 KB before 056). Lowered from 240 in 060 so a +12 KB regression like 059's duplicated header (227 KB) fails. perf-budget.mjs also fails if zod, react-hook-form or next-auth's client appear in any of them, or if the header or cart panel ships in more than one chunk (or none).
